mavzu: Unit 6 Lesson 3: Small - smaller - the smallest

savollar.savol: Matndagi qushlardan qaysilari keltirilgan?
variantlar: Peacock, Eagle, Sparrow, Swallow, Humming bird, Penguin va Ostrich

savollar.savol: "Small" sozi matndagi qaysi ma'noda?
"The smallest" qaysi shakl?
"Smaller" qaysi shakl?
"Big" ning comparative shakli qanday?
"Tall" ning superlative shakli qanday?
Matndagi sifatlarda "fast" nima?
"Slow" sifatining ma'nosi qanday?
'Sparrow' o'zbek tilida qanday ataladi?
"Small - smaller - the smallest" shaklari qaysi ketma-ketlik?
Agar penguin small bo'lsa, peacock bigger bo'lsa, ostrich qaysi bo'ladi?
"Long" ning comparative shakli qanday?
Qaysi variant comparative shakl?
"Strong" ning superlative shakli qanday?
"The penguin is bigger than the peacock" misolda qaysi sifat taqqoslanimoqda?
"Short" ning comparative shakli qanday?
A: "The peacock is big." B: "The penguin is bigger than the peacock." C qanday deyishi kerak?
"Tall" ning positive va superlative shaklari qaysilari?
Matndagi "slow" va "fast" sifatlari qaysi ma'nodagi?
Comparative shakli "-er" qo'shib tuzilsa, superlative shakli qanday tuziladi?
"Big" sifatining comparative va superlative shaklari qaysilari?
"The peacock is big. The penguin is bigger. The ostrich is the biggest." Bu qaysi ketma-ketlik?
Uchta qush: sparrow (eng kichik), penguin (o'rtacha), ostrich (eng katta). To'g'ri tavsif qaysi?
variantlar: The sparrow is smaller, the penguin is big, the ostrich is the biggest
The sparrow is small, the penguin is bigger, the ostrich is the biggest
The sparrow is small, the penguin is smaller, the ostrich is the smallest
The sparrow is the smallest, the penguin is bigger, the ostrich is the biggest

savollar.savol: "Small", "tall", "long" sifatlari uchun to'g'ri shakl qaysi?
variantlar: small-smaller-the smallest, tall-taller-the tallest, long-longer-the longest
small-more small-the most small, tall-more tall-the most tall, long-more long-the most long
small-smaller-the bigger, tall-taller-the highest, long-longer-the longest

savollar.savol: "The penguin is bigger than the peacock" misolida "than" so'zi nima uchun ishlatilgan?
Agar A<B<C va A small, B bigger than A, C the biggest bo'lsa, qaysi to'g'ri?
variantlar: The A is small, the B is bigger than the A, the C is the biggest
The A is smaller, the B is big, the C is the smallest
The A is the smallest, the B is smaller, the C is big
The A is small, the B is smaller, the C is big

savollar.savol: Matni asosida, superlative shakli "the" bilan har doim yozilinadimi?
"Fast", "slow", "long", "short" sifatlarining comparative va superlative shaklari qaysi qoidaga amal qiladi?
Agar uch shakl: bitta narsani aytish, ikki narsani taqqoslash, eng ko'p taqqoslash - bu qaysi?
"The peacock is big. The penguin is bigger. The ostrich is the biggest." - bu nima uchun har xil shaklda?
